scope.candidate_product_restriction: Native unit score support only; eligible footprint must be independently represented. Do not alter registry product type.

source.title: The global biophysical potential for mangrove restoration dataset
source.citation: Worthington et al. (2024), version v1, published 2024-05-24. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.11283186.
source.reference_status: Archive identity and members verified in prior audit; not an admitted SRC/EV finding. Source record described associated paper as In Review; later publication not established.

relationship.interpretation: Relative source-model biophysical restoration ease within historically lost mangrove units; not success probability, site feasibility or an eligible-pixel mask.
relationship.min_max_interpretation: Alternative model sensitivity, not confidence interval.

mechanism: Corrected gross mangrove loss is multiplied by the eligible driver fractions (extreme weather, non-productive conversion and commodities). Among units with positive modelled restorable area, eight categorized components capture disturbance cause, tidal setting, sea-level-rise exposure, hydrological disturbance, patch structure, connectivity and loss timing. Normalized source weights combine these into the native score. Preserve this model output without re-fitting a second suitability curve.
justification: Use the versioned model as a landscape scoping index, retaining source spatial support, eligibility assumptions and area totals. This is more traceable than transferring isolated generic climate thresholds to mangrove restoration. High score does not establish site-level tidal reconnection, land access or restoration success.

states.positive_area_positive_score: Return native score; expose area only when independent gates pass and coverage/overlay validity is known.
states.zero_area_zero_score: no_modelled_restorable_area; area=0; score=null. Source-model exclusion, not biological impossibility.
states.missing_row_value_or_geometry: unknown; score/area unresolved; never replace missing with zero.
states.invalid: Reject negative/nonfinite area, out-of-range/nonfinite score, area/score zero mismatch, bad joins or invalid geometry; no clipping.
states.boundary_only_touch: No area contribution; omit before unit evaluation.

area_accounting.default: whole source units plus unresolved partial-unit allocation bounds; no polygon prorating
area_accounting.loss_definition: GMW v3 composite across source epochs minus 2020 extent, assigned to source typology units; not 1996 minus 2020 alone
area_accounting.allocation_assumption: Unit-level corrected loss and restorable-driver proportion apply uniformly across mapped loss within that unit. This is an estimate, not a mapped eligible footprint.
area_accounting.activation_condition_for_optional_alloca: Verify release-matched loss geometry, unit assignment, CRS, validity, coverage and reconciliation with archived Loss.txt / country shares; no arbitrary layer substitution.
area_accounting.bounds_meaning: allocation bounds conditional on source model total, not ecological confidence intervals
area_accounting.overlapping_AOIs: union before allocation, unique unit IDs; component AOI totals not additive unless partitioned
area_accounting.country_statistics: use source Country_Statistics only for source country geography; carries source loss-share allocation and boundary convention
area_accounting.archived_1km_tables: totals verified; candidate future allocation route; geometry and derivation not verified, excluded from default binding
area_accounting.topology_requirement: Unique IDs do not establish nonoverlapping spatial units; validate inter-unit topology before spatial accumulation.
area_accounting.unknown_coverage: Report separately; do not claim finite complete AOI bounds if any source coverage is unknown.
prohibited: Polygon-fraction prorating of source restorable area

map_support.native: Irregular source typological polygons; vector grain, no fixed resolution.
map_support.map_only: Score visualization and source-unit comparison allowed as contextual support.
map_support.area_and_intersections: Source hectares and allocation bounds reported separately. M3/M4 pixel intersections and spatial beneficiary claims require a validated eligible footprint; support polygons cannot supply one.

preserve: Additional independent physical requirements supported by separate review
not_equivalent: Hydrological disturbance index is not all restoration feasibility
Historical commodity conversion is not present land availability

replacement.rationale: No current mangrove T4 rows at checked revision; do not delete variable names by pattern. Future overlaps need exact row identity and semantic review.
replacement.future_overlap_policy: Hold if overlap is uncertain; retain independent gates. No automatic deletion of salinity, elevation, temperature or hydroperiod.

source_refs.claim: Variable weights normalized; category ratings divided by ten; alternative ratings represent lack of consensus.
Eight components; positive restorable area filter; weighted category sum gives OVERALL_SCORE.
Alternative models and minimum/maximum sensitivity scores.
Eligible loss-driver fractions multiplied by corrected gross loss.
Gross loss is composite across source epochs minus 2020 extent, corrected for mapping error.
Join scores to units; the 348 zero-area units have no fitted score and are exported as zero.
Country allocation uses loss shares and source boundary conventions.
